summary: Hosted API: streaming response stops mid-completion (no [DONE])
description: Customer reports SSE stream frequently stops ~40-80% through the completion. Client sees open connection then silence; no terminal [DONE] event. Observed mostly during peak hours. They are using our OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions with stream=true. Impact: user-facing chat tool shows partial answer then hangs until client timeout.
comments: Support (Avery): Asked customer for request IDs + exact timestamps. Customer provided 6 request_ids and noted they see it more on wifi/corp proxy.
Eng (Ethan): Checked api-gateway logs: responses end with upstream reset (RST) from edge to gateway for several request_ids. Correlates with elevated connection churn on us-east edge.
SRE (Hannah Schmitt): Suspect idle timeout mismatch between edge and gateway for long-lived SSE; investigating config drift after last edge rollout.
Support: Shared workaround: set client read timeout >= 120s and enable automatic reconnect w/ resume (if possible). Customer says reconnect helps but still sees truncation.
